oidc.assessment: Mixed in both arms; one advisory-arm native validation failure before schema clarification.
strengths: Several proposals require documentation or configuration to classify public versus protected data.
Some proposals distinguish permitted issuer destinations or credential audiences from forbidden ones.
limitations: Client-specific fields, response differences and nonstandard metadata are sometimes treated as sensitive without sufficient audience distinction.
Several SSRF-style positives establish ordinary fetching rather than a prohibited destination or protected consequence.
Extra issuer/SSRF mechanisms remain conditional despite no supplied issuer input.
Advisory repetition 0 failed cross-field identity validation: comparison hypotheses require explicit roles.
oidc.comparison: No general discrimination uplift established; retain the failed result without sampling until success.

chat.assessment: Mixed in both arms; no general discrimination uplift established.
strengths: Several proposals include controlled request variations, unique markers and server attribution.
Unknown JSON field mapping, tool execution and property binding are generally explicit prerequisites.
limitations: A prompt marker or obedience can be ordinary requested chat behavior rather than a crossed instruction boundary.
A correlated callback establishes server fetching, not a prohibited destination by itself.
Persistence of an extra property can be legitimate extensibility without a protected-property write restriction.
chat.scope: Only SSRF module guidance is supplied; prompt-injection and mass-assignment observations assess general design from method requests and shared principles, not adoption of absent dedicated guides.

filesystem.assessment: Meaningful conditional comparison in all five executed outputs; one baseline case blocked by planning.
strengths: Allowed and outside fixture markers are compared against an independently established root policy.
Nonexistent-path controls distinguish fixture content from generic errors or fallback pages.
Unknown containment enforcement remains a future prerequisite rather than requiring completed exploitation.
limitations: No target execution or actual containment failure is established.

identity_schema.assessment: Native validation improved in this small probe, but role declaration remains unresolved.
limitations: All described CSRF outputs still left roles empty despite authenticated future procedures.
The focused input is smaller than production and does not supply a declared role catalog.
Do not infer correct identity authoring or an end-to-end uplift from native validation.
